mintAuthority.summary: OUSD has native Bridge issuance on Tempo, Ethereum, Base and Solana. Each observed issuance creates or consumes a local reserve ledger, rather than proving a remote-chain representation. Issuer administrators can raise caps, authorize minters or replace mint logic. Whole-supply issuer reporting reconciles reserve assets against outstanding OUSD; internal ledgers are not independent reserve assurance.

controls.label: Bridge (Stripe) issuance backend
controls.evidence: Bridge Building Inc. operates OUSD primary issuance through Bridge's centralized backend, rather than a permissionless or user-collateralized route. The Bridge launch statement names the current issuer and says OUSD is live on Base, Ethereum, Solana and Tempo; Open Standard's launch statement identifies these exact native contracts and says every integration path supports 1:1 mint/burn. Native issuance was observed separately on all four deployments: Tempo transaction 0x2fd5beb56ddbbc67f7a37d8b6b6b0d9672fd1b4572999ce6b4f43b7134f6f155 at block 41967286 creates local reserve-ledger supply and OUSD (RPC https://rpc.tempo.xyz, observed 2026-09-30T16:24:40.633Z); Base transaction 0x24e9953d8efd8744eed28be5f3c43cd5a7856157ca39e55b840f996269ac0aac at block 51997796 creates local reserve-ledger supply and native OUSD (RPC https://mainnet.base.org, observed 2026-09-30T16:24:41.414Z); Solana transaction ncPiAZyBwkau1Fm7PaQ2QgrzuYaAPWMcwfj6WX9nkKFbovdVWJdJG6HmgRn63v5bhnXUSJBUVihKyNtJupNz1kz at slot 452017788 creates local reserve-ledger supply and OUSD via the Bridge program, signed by backend 3ZGf3ERiitfTR9RCChchfo7QWmSfH1WArJ3jjrtMXnKa (RPC https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com, observed 2026-09-30T16:37:02.331Z); Ethereum transaction 0x4344b061cc70ad671bf18b83c96253a01e6244ba3c622641e31167a0050b8527 at block 26091440 from backend 0x19810813f2e46cf01e7c543f6d8c3ecc8ea2001e calls TokenAuthority 0x0198f9d5c8e8ef8869d70d387d3efa997f727464 and emits local ReserveLedger issuance plus 12 OUSD (RPC https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, transaction/receipt observed 2026-09-30T19:26:54.482Z). The backend describes the common issuer-operated primary-market capability, not a common blockchain private key: the separate EVM administrators and Solana authorities retain only their evidenced deployment reach.
